items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: I can't -- I don't remember what happened (to Lannie) during that period.

ctx.x: No, no. Either didn't --. Let me see what happened to Lonnie now. I think Lonnie came over there for

a while, and then he left -- something happened to him -- and there was just two of us. I can't -- I don't remember what happened (to Lannie) during that period. But, anyway, it was just the two of us.
But, you really -- you got your ABC's then?
